components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The filled action used for the most direct next step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:13px; padding:0 18px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-sm); background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); cursor:pointer; font:700 13px/1.2 Manrope,sans-serif; transition:color 180ms var(--ease-out), background-color 180ms var(--ease-out), transform 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The outlined alternative beside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 18px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:var(--radius-sm); background:rgba(12,13,16,.62); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font:700 13px/1.2 Manrope,sans-serif; transition:color 180ms var(--ease-out), border-color 180ms var(--ease-out), background-color 180ms var(--ease-out), transform 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-hover); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: A labeled text control in the contact form.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-contact">Project details</label><input class="ds-text-field" id="ds-contact" type="text" placeholder="What would you like to build?" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--muted); font:700 11px/1.4 Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-text-field { display:block; width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:11px 13px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:var(--radius-sm); background:rgba(14,16,20,.88); color:var(--text); font:400 13px/1.5 Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-text-field::placeholder { color:var(--quiet); opacity:1; } .ds-text-field:focus { border-color:var(--accent); background:#101319; outline:none; } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A quiet link row with a clear current-section state.
components.html: ProjectsServicesAbout
components.css: .ds-navigation { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:clamp(22px,3vw,42px); } .ds-nav-link { display:inline-flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; color:var(--muted); font:600 13px/1.4 Manrope,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-current { color:var(--text); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; } @media (max-width:820px) { .ds-navigation { display:grid; gap:0; } .ds-nav-link { min-height:49px; font-size:14px; } }

components.name: Project Screenshot Frame
components.description: A large, restrained frame that lets a real project screenshot carry the proof.
components.css: .ds-project-frame { display:block; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius-md); background:var(--surface); } .ds-project-frame img { display:block; width:100%; aspect-ratio:1.58; object-fit:cover; object-position:center top; transition:transform 400ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-project-frame:hover img { transform:scale(1.015); } .ds-project-frame:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
The visual system gives business owners a calm, capable first impression. Near-black surfaces, precise sans-serif typography, and clear project proof create a technical character without resorting to spectacle. The interface stays direct and legible so the offer, real work, and contact paths carry the weight.

A very faint perspective grid is the recurring background signature. Fine dividers, open space, restrained corners, and large project imagery keep that motif behind the content. The portrait supplies a natural human counterpoint to the measured layout.
keyCharacteristics: One muted periwinkle accent for actions, focus, and small markers.
Manrope typography, fine separators, restrained corners, and large real project imagery.
A low-contrast perspective grid that remains behind text and screenshots.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep the cool blue accent scarce and purposeful; let project images and copy remain the main visual proof.

rules.name: The Content-First Grid Rule
rules.body: The perspective grid is a quiet page-wide signature; text and project screenshots must remain more noticeable than its lines.

dos: Do use the accent for one clear action, keyboard focus, and limited markers.
Do preserve the faint perspective grid across the page with content visually in front.
Do give real project screenshots generous space and alternate their alignment for rhythm.
Do retain readable contrast, visible focus, reduced-motion support, and comfortable mobile spacing.
Do keep locale and contact controls clear in all three language variants.
donts: Don't introduce neon cyan, several competing bright accents, glow-heavy controls, or decorative particles.
Don't use gradient headlines, a custom cursor, a typing effect, or a noisy animated background.
Don't let the grid compete with text or screenshots.
Don't add fake ratings, outcome figures, testimonials, or invented experience claims.
Don't turn every section into a rounded card or pill badge.
